rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because deleting the sole production ALB has severity 5 (complete customer-facing outage) and blast_radius 5 (all customer traffic affected); Sub-classifier B halts because the deletion permanently removes the load balancer and its DNS endpoint (mutates_persistent_state), disrupts external customer traffic for at least the DNS TTL period with no recall (external_side_effect), and no standby ALB or documented rollback procedure exists (no_rollback_procedure).
